mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate falling below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which together drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contracting (INDPRO < 100) indicates manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts figure exceeding 600.0 thousand units signals strong residential construction and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 600.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), aggressive rate hikes suppress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
